summary_en: This phase 3 study compares opevesostat (MK-5684) with abiraterone acetate or enzalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that was previously treated with a next-generation hormonal agent and taxane-based chemotherapy. Opevesostat is taken by mouth as 5 mg tablets twice daily, with dexamethasone and fludrocortisone acetate once daily, until progression. The main outcome measured is overall survival (OS).
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara opevesostat (MK-5684) con acetato de abiraterona o enzalutamida en cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración que fue tratado previamente con un agente hormonal de nueva generación y quimioterapia basada en taxanos. El opevesostat se toma por vía oral en tabletas de 5 mg dos veces al día, junto con dexametasona y acetato de fludrocortisona una vez al día, hasta la progresión. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia global (OS).
who_for: Adenocarcinoma of the prostate confirmed by biopsy or cytology, without small cell histology
Prostate cancer progressed on androgen deprivation therapy within 6 months before screening, with distant metastatic disease
Disease progressed during or after one novel hormonal agent
Received 1 to 2 taxane-based chemotherapy regimens for mCRPC, with progression during or after treatment
not_for: Gastrointestinal disorder that might affect drug absorption
Poorly controlled diabetes or clinically significant abnormal potassium or sodium levels
Active or unstable cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease, or recent seizures
Known active central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
